svg.title: Craft backend meta-types · CyberAlchemy Lab
svg.desc: Thirteen unique definition nodes, twenty-two branches representing seventeen canonical signatures, with no arrow crossings or overlapping segments. Definitions use 24-point text. Dashed Enum reference is field typing rather than a canonical signature. Branded with the official CyberAlchemy Lab vector logo and exact website Paper & crimson palette tokens.

g.text: Typed record of a fact that

svg.text: Solid arrows: canonical signatures. Dashed arrow: field typing. Entity loops relate Entity instances.
Saga is represented by Workflow. Animation guides reading; it does not prescribe an execution order.

g.text: Identity, values, behavior, boundaries and lifecycle.
Rules gate; Calculations derive; Workflows coordinate.
Interfaces expose; Policies choose; Mappings project.
Reads, creation, embedded values and event subjects.
Events activate behavior; Operations project to other features.
Lifecycle responsibility and assignment carry different meaning.
